title: Spigadolce | Authentic Pugliese Cooking Experiences in London

hero.heading: Learn to Cook Authentic Pugliese Food in London
hero.subheading: Hands-on 3-hour classes: pasta, sauces and traditional dishes. In a warm, welcoming atmosphere or at our partner restaurants.

intro.text: Step into my kitchen and feel the warmth of a Pugliese home. I'll teach you to shape orecchiette by hand, stir a slow-simmered sugo and sit down together to enjoy every bite — the way my family has done for generations.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subheading: Three hours to learn, cook and share a complete Pugliese meal

steps.title: Knead
steps.description: Learn to make fresh pasta by hand using traditional Pugliese techniques — orecchiette, cavatelli, tagliatelle and more.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Prepare a traditional sauce and complete the dish. Every class includes a starter, a pasta course and a Pugliese sweet.

steps.title: Feast
steps.description: Sit down at the table and savour what you've created, with a glass of Pugliese wine. Take the recipe home with you.

locations.heading: Where We Cook
locations.subheading: Intimate home classes or larger groups at our partner restaurants

home.title: At My Home
home.description: Wimbledon, SW19 — A warm, intimate setting for up to 6 guests. Like stepping into the kitchen of a Pugliese family home.

restaurant.title: Partner Restaurants
restaurant.description: La Pizzica, Il Circolo and more — Groups of up to 20. Perfect for team building, celebrations and special occasions.

testimonials.heading: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subheading: Stories from people who joined our classes

items.text: Perfect for a birthday celebration! The pasta was delicious and Riccardina is a brilliant teacher. We all left with the recipe and new skills we can't wait to try at home.

items.text: The best team building we've ever done. Fun, hands-on and the food was exceptional. Everyone in the office is still talking about it weeks later!
items.author: Laura C.
